g.text: Extension taxes less subsidies per item for United States (USA), a FABIO-internal decomposition; the World
Bank reference is TOTAL-only, so no WB line is drawn. Taxes less subsidies is the production-side measure
throughout. Blue line/triangles on the Primary (ISIC-A) row(s) = external A01+A03 taxes less subsidies
benchmark (OECD_SUT; exported by scripts 02/03), a primary-agriculture, forestry-free reference for the
covered years. Items grouped as "Other" exactly as in the TOTAL figure (below 3% max |share| of WB across
